news.headline: Fontainebleau forest near Paris reopens after devastating wildfire
news.summary: Fontainebleau forest reopened to the public Saturday, with 80 percent of the popular Paris-area nature reserve accessible again after a wildfire scorched around 2,000 hectares last month. A fifth of the forest remains closed because of safety risks.

news.headline: Infantino defies FIFA vice president's request to stay away from Caribbean youth tournament
